input.rationale: Section 9 is limited to mutual corporate-existence, authority, enforceability and no-conflict representations (p0056-p0057) plus an HDI acknowledgement regarding the Globix Agreement (p0058). Nothing in the Agreement contains an express HDI warranty that the design, development, hosting and maintenance services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, that the Site will conform to agreed specifications for any period, that HDI will comply with applicable law, or that the Site will be free of malicious code, and there is no repair/re-performance/refund remedy. Section 1.6 (operational deadline) and Section 5.2 (Company acceptance) are delivery and approval mechanics, not warranties. There is no disclaimer section, so this is not walk-away "AS IS" territory, but the absence of any express performance warranty falls short of even the fallback (90 days software / 30 days services with remedies). Per the detection guidance, a missing express warranty is cured by insertion, so we propose a new Section 9(c) at the preferred position.

proposal.summary: Add an express HDI performance warranty (workmanlike services, 90-day conformance of the Site, legal compliance, no malicious code) with a repair/re-perform/refund remedy.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 contains only mutual authority warranties, so HDI gives no warranty at all on the design, development or hosting work it is paid to perform. We have added a standard performance warranty with a 90-day conformance period and a re-performance/repair/refund remedy, consistent with our playbook position; we can discuss the exact conformance period if helpful.

ops.text: (c) HDI represents and warrants to the Company that: (1) the design, development, implementation, operation, maintenance, management and hosting services performed by HDI under this Agreement (the "Services") will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner consistent with industry standards; (2) for a period of ninety (90) days following the Company's acceptance and approval of the Site (or any portion thereof or other deliverable) pursuant to Section 5.2, the Site and each such deliverable will conform in all material respects to the specifications and documentation agreed by the Parties; (3) HDI will perform the Services in compliance with all applicable laws, rules and regulations; and (4) the Site and any software or other materials provided by HDI will not contain any virus, worm, disabling device or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this Section 9(c) shall be, at HDI's option, re-performance of the non-conforming Services, repair or replacement of the non-conforming deliverable, or a refund of the fees paid to HDI in respect of the non-conforming Services or deliverable.
